name: @gemma/assets
description: Shared static brand assets consumed by both apps (logos: Gemma wordmark, Gemma glyph, UBC, MSL). Each .png ships beside its editable .xcf GIMP source so the source art can never drift from — or be misplaced apart from — the exported image; the four MSL cuts are the exception, supplied as exports with no source art. Only the .png files are imported (via ./src/index.ts); the .xcf sources are co-located but never bundled. Add an asset here only when both apps/browser and apps/curation would otherwise copy it.
